## Summary

Describe the focused change and link the related issue.

## Verification

- [ ] Session tests run, or explain why not
- [ ] Build verified, or explain why not
- [ ] Window/link tests run if lifecycle behavior changed
- [ ] No credentials, real account data, runtime logs, or private signing material included
- [ ] Documentation distinguishes tested behavior from assumptions
- [ ] Contribution/reuse permissions discussed with the owner (no open-source license currently granted)

## Known limitations / live testing

State exactly what was and was not tested.
